name: k-humanizer
description: An Agent Skill that translates English into natural Korean for Korean customers, keeping prices, dates, policies, and placeholders exact.

interface.longDescription: An Agent Skill that translates English into natural Korean for Korean customers, keeping prices, dates, policies, and placeholders exact. Includes k-humanizer for customer-facing and native Korean writing, and k-humanizer-resume for Korean resumes, career descriptions, portfolio summaries, LinkedIn profiles, and job application essays.
defaultPrompt: Translate this English text into natural Korean for Korean customers, keeping prices, dates, policies, and placeholders exact.
Edit this Korean resume so it reads naturally while preserving the supplied evidence, ownership, and metrics.
